description: This file defines the interface for a command management system in a C software project. It includes function declarations for creating, destroying, executing, and managing command objects, along with accessors and utility functions related to command usage and options.

methods.name: commandCreate
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new Command instance with specified name, aliases, usage details, argument constraints, and execution function.

methods.name: commandDestroy
methods.description: Releases resources associated with a Command instance.

methods.name: commandGetName
methods.description: Retrieves the long name of the command; caller is responsible for freeing the returned string.

methods.name: commandGetShortName
methods.description: Retrieves an optional short name (alias) for the command; caller must free the returned string.

methods.name: commandSetAdvanced
methods.description: Marks a command as 'advanced', affecting its visibility in the user interface depending on mode.

methods.name: commandExecute
methods.description: Executes a command with provided argument count and array; returns true if successful.

methods.name: commandAddExample
methods.description: Adds an example usage string to aid user understanding of command usage.

methods.name: commandPrintUsage
methods.description: Outputs the usage information for a command, considering current mode flags.
